summary: Iteration 2 backend testing for inline recap-row edition endpoints (PATCH/POST/DELETE) + regression. 39/41 tests passed (95%). All 16 previous regression tests still pass. New endpoints work as specified except for one bug: quantite numeric (int/float) inputs are rejected by Pydantic validation with 422 (string-only schema), violating the requirement 'Quantité acceptée en string et nombre'.

critical.issue: RecapRowUpdate.quantite is typed Optional[str]; sending JSON number (e.g. 42 or 42.5) returns 422 'Input should be a valid string'. Spec requires accepting both string and number. _parse_quantite already handles int/float, only the Pydantic field type needs to be Union[str, float, int, None] (or Any).

minor.issue: When kind='manual' is updated to all-empty + quantite=='0', a numeric 0 also triggers kind='empty'; behaviour matches spec but is an implicit truthiness rule worth documenting (a legitimate manual row with quantite=0 cannot exist).
Edits persist only in-memory; a backend restart wipes manual rows. Acceptable for MVP but should be flagged.

action_items: Fix Pydantic model RecapRowUpdate in /app/backend/server.py (~line 346): change `quantite: Optional[str] = ''` to `quantite: Optional[Union[str, float, int]] = ''` (and import Union) OR use `Any`. _parse_quantite already handles numbers correctly — only the schema rejects them.
critical_code_review_comments: RecapRowUpdate.quantite typed as Optional[str] contradicts the requirement to accept numbers; _parse_quantite handles both but the model layer rejects numeric JSON values with 422.
delete_recap_row returns {'ok': true, 'remaining': N} — consider also returning the deleted row for client undo support.
Manual rows are stored in-memory only (DATASTORE); not persisted to Mongo. A server restart loses all manual edits. Document or persist.
kind transitions: PATCH a 'manual' row with all-empty fields silently transitions it to 'empty'. A manual row with quantite==0 cannot be expressed (treated as empty). Worth a doc note.
seed_data_creation: Reused /tmp/sample.xlsx (19780 rows). Tests add/edit/delete recap rows transactionally with cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the RecapRowUpdate.quantite type (accept str|float|int), rerun /app/backend/tests/test_recap_row_edit.py — the two failing parametrized cases (numeric 42 and 42.5) should pass. All other 39 tests already green. Sample fixture at /tmp/sample.xlsx still valid.
rca of the issue: Pydantic v2 strict type checking on RecapRowUpdate.quantite: Optional[str] = '' rejects JSON numbers before they reach _parse_quantite. Reproduction: `curl -X PATCH .../recap-row/<idx> -d '{"quantite": 42}'` returns 422. Mitigation: change field type to Optional[Union[str, float, int]] or Optional[Any]. _parse_quantite already converts int/float to float so no other code change needed.
